ABOUT THE AREA Dubailand Residence Complex is located in Dubai Land a.k.a Wadi Al Safa 5. It is accessible by main Dubai highways that makes its location convenient for residents to get to and from main key points in the city. Dubai is a city and emirate in the United Arab Emirates known for luxury shopping, ultramodern architecture and a lively nightlife scene. Burj Khalifa, an 830m-tall tower, dominates the skyscraper-filled skyline. At its foot lies Dubai Fountain, with jets and lights choreographed to music. On artificial islands just offshore is Atlantis, The Palm, a resort with water and marine-animal parks. With the world's tallest building, the world's biggest shopping mall and the world's biggest choreographed fountain, Dubai's a city that breaks records for fun. Glamorous hotels on purpose-built islands and seven-figure yachts are all part of the fabric of the UAE's answer to Tinsel Town. Its ever-evolving city centre's just one of the things that makes it a must-see. And because the skyline is always getting bigger and bolder, it's not uncommon to see a spot of construction work going on around the city. Dubai's shoreline's a real eye-catcher, and not just because of the stellar sands. True to form, the city ups the game with a huge, hotel-studded island shaped like a giant palm tree. From here, you can spy one of the city's most iconic skyscrapers - the sail-shaped Burj Al-Arab - from your lounger. Sunbathing's a year-round pastime in Dubai, thanks to a steady dose of sunshine. In peak summer - July and August - the mercury can reach 40oC. And, even in the winter months, from December to March, the temperature rarely dips below 17oC. title: Downtown Dubai, Dubai
description: DWTN Residences is a landmark residential development that redefines vertical living through a unique concept of six dedicated lifestyle ecosystems integrated throughout the tower. The project comprises a limited collection of 432 exclusive residences and 90 signature residences, including one- to three-bedroom apartments, duplexes, penthouses, and an ultra-exclusive royal palace. The architectural concept transforms a traditional residential tower into a self-contained vertical community, where each ecosystem is designed to support different aspects of daily life. Particular attention has been given to spatial planning, natural light, and the seamless flow between living spaces, creating residences that combine functionality with contemporary sophistication. The development offers more than 75,000 square feet of amenities distributed across multiple levels of the tower. These lifestyle ecosystems are designed to support wellness, recreation, social interaction, business activities, relaxation, and entertainment. Residents benefit from a comprehensive range of facilities that create dedicated environments for fitness, leisure, community engagement, professional needs, and private celebrations, providing a complete residential experience within a single development. The residences feature premium materials and carefully executed interior finishes throughout. The design palette incorporates warm neutral tones, accents inspired by Gulf waters, and refined metallic details that contribute to a contemporary aesthetic. Kitchens are fully equipped with built-in appliances. Residences are delivered without furniture. The overall specification reflects modern finishing with high-quality materials and a strong emphasis on craftsmanship, comfort, and visual refinement. Location description and benefits Business Bay is one of Dubai's most dynamic and fast-paced neighborhoods, known as the city's central business, commercial, and residential hub. Located just minutes from Downtown Dubai and the iconic Burj Khalifa, it offers a strategic location with seamless access to Sheikh Zayed Road and Al Khail Road. Business Bay is a prime destination for professionals, entrepreneurs, and investors looking to be at the heart of Dubai's thriving economy, with a skyline defined by high-rise towers, luxury hotels, and modern office spaces. Designed to embody sophistication and architectural excellence, the complex stands as a symbol of branded luxury living in Dubai. The development offers a refined selection of studios and one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, thoughtfully designed to suit both homeowners and investors. Interiors showcase a contemporary aesthetic defined by clean architectural lines, premium materials, rich textures, and a warm, elegant color palette. Surrounding the racecourse are premium residential communities, leisure destinations, retail concepts, and wellness-focused spaces, all thoughtfully integrated to support a high-quality lifestyle. Wide boulevards, pedestrian-friendly planning, and scenic vistas define the everyday experience in Meydan. Strategically located with excellent connectivity to Downtown Dubai, Business Bay, DIFC, and Dubai International Airport, Meydan offers both lifestyle appeal and strong investment potential. Its limited land availability, ongoing development momentum, and growing demand for branded and luxury residences position Meydan as a prime destination for end-users and investors seeking long-term value in one of Dubai's most forward-looking districts.

description: Verso is a contemporary residential development by Reportage Properties in Meydan, Dubai, offering one-, two- and four-bedroom apartments within a 15-storey tower. About Verso Verso is a residential development by Reportage Properties in Bukadra, forming part of the wider Meydan Horizon district. The project brings together apartments and ground-level retail within a building organised across two basement levels, a ground floor, two podium levels and 15 residential floors. The residential collection comprises one-, two- and four-bedroom apartments, with published layouts starting at approximately 505 sq. ft. The range is relatively focused, moving from more compact one-bedroom homes to larger four-bedroom residences. The design includes private balconies and terraces, with built-in wardrobes, fully tiled bathrooms, and contemporary kitchen cabinetry and countertops. Large windows, double-glazed glazing and fibre-optic connectivity are among the documented features of the residences. The interiors use a contemporary approach with practical finishes and a neutral palette, keeping the emphasis on straightforward, functional living rather than elaborate detailing. The amenity programme focuses on outdoor recreation, fitness, and family use. A main swimming pool and pool deck sit alongside a children's pool and splash zone, while a padel court, gym and yoga area provide dedicated spaces for exercise. Landscaped areas and shaded seating create quieter outdoor spaces, complemented by children's play facilities and recreational areas including foosball and table tennis. The development's location is a defining characteristic. Bukadra sits within the wider Meydan area, placing Verso within reach of Downtown Dubai, Dubai Mall, Dubai Design District, Dubai Creek Harbour and Meydan Racecourse. Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary is also nearby, providing a contrasting natural landscape to the increasingly urban surroundings. Verso is therefore positioned around a relatively simple residential proposition: contemporary apartments, a practical amenity programme, and access to several established Dubai destinations, within a district that continues to develop. description: Lunara Tower by Tarrad Development emerges as an exceptional residential address, a beautifully proportioned building of seven residential floors rising above a ground level and two basement levels, offering a curated collection of one and two-bedroom homes. Comprising one hundred and nineteen residences, this thoughtfully designed development achieves remarkable efficiency, with sellable area representing a remarkable proportion of the allowable gross floor area. Every residence has been carefully planned to maximise space, light, and comfort, creating a refined sanctuary where contemporary design meets everyday practicality. The amenities at Lunara Tower are thoughtfully gathered on a complete rooftop level, creating a vibrant social hub for residents to enjoy. The rooftop features a stunning swimming pool and a dedicated kids' pool, alongside a fully equipped gymnasium, a serene spa, and a beautifully appointed co-working space for those who work from home. Residents also enjoy a games room, a kids' play area, a multipurpose hall, a barbecue area, a padel court, and an amenities reception, ensuring that relaxation, wellness, productivity, and connection are all effortlessly catered for within the building. The residences at Lunara Tower are beautifully furnished, with every detail carefully considered to create an atmosphere of warmth and refined living. The interiors showcase a harmonious palette of ivory stone tones, champagne metal accents, and colourless glass, while continuous balcony bands, slender dark glazing frames, and sculptural supports establish a recognisable residential identity. Each home is delivered fully furnished with premium finishes, ensuring that residents can immediately immerse themselves in the comfort and elegance of their new home, while the chamfered corners and clear glazing articulate the building's presence on its three street frontages with quiet distinction. Location description and benefits Wadi Al Safa 3 offers a well-connected and increasingly desirable setting, positioned along three road frontages that provide excellent accessibility to the wider city. This thriving neighbourhood is served by the Sheikh Mohammed bin Zayed Road as its principal regional connection, alongside Dubai-Al Ain Road and Umm Suqeim Street, ensuring that every journey is effortless and every destination within comfortable reach. The area's strategic position places it at the heart of a rapidly evolving district, where convenience and opportunity converge. The neighbourhood enjoys outstanding connectivity to the city's most popular destinations, with IMG Worlds of Adventure and Global Village just moments away, alongside Dubai Hills Mall, Dubai International Academic City, and Mall of the Emirates all within an easy journey. Residents benefit from proximity to the iconic Dubai Mall and Downtown district, Dubai Marina Mall, and Dubai International Airport, making both business and leisure effortlessly accessible. For global travel, Al Maktoum International Airport is also within comfortable reach, ensuring that the world is always close at hand. The surroundings offer a wealth of retail, dining, and entertainment experiences that enrich daily life, from world-class shopping destinations to vibrant cultural and leisure attractions. The area's continued growth and investment in infrastructure signal a bright future, making it an increasingly attractive choice for homeowners and investors seeking both comfort and long-term value. This distinguished location truly offers the best of both worlds, combining the tranquillity of a well-planned community with the dynamic energy of one of the world's most exciting cities.

description: Binghatti Titania at Majan is a high-rise 38-storey ultra-luxury advanced architectural excellence, above the podium levels, developed by leading Binghatti Developers . Laced with premium of the prime designed exclusive edition studios, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments to satisfy your luxury thirst to redefine the lifestyle. Being inspired from the Mythos tale, and rising with sovereign confidence as 3B+G+4P+32 residential floors with mech. and roof floor from the majan corridor. The tower commands immediate bold attention through a distinctive façade defined by a dark, metallic geometric grid that contrasts deliberately and dramatically against expansive glass surface, between structure and transparency that gives the building a rare character. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The result is a residential atmosphere that feels simultaneously expansive and intimate, modern and enduring, a place where the design draws back deliberately to place the resident and their sense of stillness at the centre of every room. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. The podium level opens into an adult infinity pool and shallow water pool that appear to dissolve into the Dubai skyline beyond as one of the tower's most photogenic and experientially powerful spaces. Families are catered for through a dedicated children's swimming pool paired with an Aqua Joy water splash zone, while the Little Marvels play area provides a curated outdoor environment for younger residents. Wellness is addressed through a yoga zone and a fully equipped gym, and the social dimension of community life is enriched through a floating pergola deck, outdoor seating areas, landscaped walkways, and abundant green spaces that soften the podium's urban edge. Residents also benefit from immediate proximity to Al Barari's cycling tracks and natural reserves, Majan Park, Majan Active Park, and the Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club, a constellation of leisure and green infrastructure. Project Highlights: The tower rises across 32 residential floors with a striking dark metallic geometric façade contrasting bold glass surfaces. A total of 789 residences span studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartment configurations across the entire development. Premium interiors feature Patagonia marble, Oakwood panelling, bronze trims, and signature green brushed steel throughout every residence. Residents enjoy direct road access to E311, Sheikh Zayed Road, Umm Suqeim Street, and Dubai-Al Ain Road. Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are reachable within fifteen to twenty-five minutes from the tower's Majan address. The amenity deck features an infinity pool, children's splash zone, yoga area, gym, and landscaped pergola deck.

title: Majan, Dubai
description: Binghatti Titania at Majan is a high-rise 38-storey ultra-luxury advanced architectural excellence, above the podium levels, developed by leading Binghatti Developers . Laced with premium of the prime designed exclusive edition studios, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments to satisfy your luxury thirst to redefine the lifestyle. Being inspired from the Mythos tale, and rising with sovereign confidence as 3B+G+4P+32 residential floors with mech. and roof floor from the majan corridor. The tower commands immediate bold attention through a distinctive façade defined by a dark, metallic geometric grid that contrasts deliberately and dramatically against expansive glass surface, between structure and transparency that gives the building a rare character. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The result is a residential atmosphere that feels simultaneously expansive and intimate, modern and enduring, a place where the design draws back deliberately to place the resident and their sense of stillness at the centre of every room. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. The podium level opens into an adult infinity pool and shallow water pool that appear to dissolve into the Dubai skyline beyond as one of the tower's most photogenic and experientially powerful spaces. Families are catered for through a dedicated children's swimming pool paired with an Aqua Joy water splash zone, while the Little Marvels play area provides a curated outdoor environment for younger residents. Wellness is addressed through a yoga zone and a fully equipped gym, and the social dimension of community life is enriched through a floating pergola deck, outdoor seating areas, landscaped walkways, and abundant green spaces that soften the podium's urban edge. Residents also benefit from immediate proximity to Al Barari's cycling tracks and natural reserves, Majan Park, Majan Active Park, and the Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club, a constellation of leisure and green infrastructure. Project Highlights: The tower rises across 32 residential floors with a striking dark metallic geometric façade contrasting bold glass surfaces. A total of 789 residences span studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartment configurations across the entire development. Premium interiors feature Patagonia marble, Oakwood panelling, bronze trims, and signature green brushed steel throughout every residence. Residents enjoy direct road access to E311, Sheikh Zayed Road, Umm Suqeim Street, and Dubai-Al Ain Road. Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are reachable within fifteen to twenty-five minutes from the tower's Majan address. The amenity deck features an infinity pool, children's splash zone, yoga area, gym, and landscaped pergola deck.

description: The Arabian Gulf does not offer this view to everyone. At Samana Ocean Crest, it comes with your morning coffee. Fifty-six residences. One island. No compromise. Developed by Samana Developers - ranked fifth among Dubai's highest off-plan sellers by volume in the first half of 2025, with a portfolio valued at over AED 17 billion - Ocean Crest represents the developer's most considered coastal statement to date. Positioned on Dubai Islands, the Nakheel-masterplanned destination that redefines what island living means in this city, the project rises across eight residential floors with a discipline of scale that most developers would not allow themselves: just 56 residences, each one crafted with the attention that only boutique numbers permit. Many homes feature private terrace pools, interiors finished in warm natural stone, wood, and glass, and layouts calibrated around panoramic sea and skyline perspectives. Samana has built its reputation on delivering resort-style living as a lived experience rather than a marketing promise - and Ocean Crest is where that philosophy meets the Gulf itself. THE EXPERIENCE: Life at Ocean Crest operates at the cadence of the sea. Mornings open to the Arabian Gulf with no obstruction, afternoons unfold across a resort-grade amenity landscape, and evenings carry the particular stillness that only island addresses can offer. This is not urban living softened by a view. It is coastal living, fully committed. Private terrace pools - select residences with direct pool access from your own outdoor space Infinity pool and sun deck - a skyline-facing water environment designed for unhurried days Yoga studios and wellness spaces - dedicated areas for restoration alongside the water's edge Spa, sauna, and steam rooms - a full wellness facility integrated into the building's daily rhythm Children's splash pad and family zones - thoughtfully separated spaces for every generation Landscaped gardens and jogging tracks - green corridors woven into the island environment 24/7 concierge and artistic lobby - a resident arrival experience that sets the register from the first step THE INVESTMENT CASE: Dubai Islands is one of the few remaining large-scale waterfront destinations in Dubai where early capital allocation still carries meaningful upside - a Nakheel-developed master community with confirmed infrastructure, beach access, and a pipeline of hospitality and retail that will anchor long-term demand. Ocean Crest's boutique scale of 56 residences operates as a natural scarcity lever in a market where oversupply is the persistent structural risk. Samana's 86% foreign investor demand ratio confirms the international conviction behind the developer's product - and a freehold title on a beachfront island address, at a confirmed entry point of AED 2.2M, positions this well within reach of the buyer profile that this location will continue to attract. With handover in Q3 2028 and a 20/70/10 payment plan, the capital deployment is structured to carry investors through the community's most active development phase. WHO THIS IS FOR: This is for those who have spent enough time in landlocked buildings and have decided, with some finality, that the water is non-negotiable. People who want their Dubai address to signal something more specific than premium - something coastal, considered, and genuinely rare at this scale. Buyers who understand the arithmetic of boutique beachfront freehold on an emerging island master plan, and who also simply want to swim in their own pool on a Tuesday morning with nothing but the Gulf in front of them. Ocean Crest. Fifty-six chances to own the edge of the island.

Set on the seventh floor of Aqua Arc, the corner plan combines sea and internal-landscape views with a remarkable 2,099.39 sq ft private terrace and an asking price of AED 8,558,998. The pool belongs to the residence and occupies the outer arc of the terrace. It is not several floors away within a shared amenity deck. That single distinction changes how the home can be used: the outdoor space becomes a private setting for quiet mornings, open-air dining and evenings hosted above Al Marjan Island. Inside, the 1,202.87 sq ft (111.75 m²) suite is planned as a complete two-bedroom home. The entrance creates a clear transition into the living areas, with a 2.0 by 2.5 metre kitchen connecting naturally to the 4.6 by 5.2 metre living and dining room. The curved frontage draws the eye toward the terrace, allowing the interior to remain visually connected with the pool and the changing outlook beyond it. The private accommodation sits away from the main social space. The principal bedroom measures 3.8 by 4.2 metres and is paired with a substantial 2.8 by 3.6 metre bathroom. The second bedroom measures 3.3 by 4.2 metres and is served by another full bathroom. A separate powder room keeps guest use away from the bedroom accommodation, while a dedicated laundry preserves the kitchen as part of the home's entertaining space. The terrace is the defining room. At approximately 195.04 m², it offers enough breadth to compose several outdoor zones instead of forcing every activity into one arrangement. There is scope for dining near the living room, a more relaxed lounge along the curved frontage and sun loungers beside the private pool. These are potential uses rather than included furnishings, but the physical proportions make each possible without compromising circulation. The seventh-floor corner position gives the residence two distinct outlooks. One aspect turns toward the sea; the other takes in Aqua Arc's internal landscape. The view therefore develops as one moves around the terrace rather than presenting a single fixed elevation. Together with the pool and the sweep of the architecture, that dual aspect gives the apartment a sense of privacy and occasion normally associated with a resort home. Aqua Arc's design is shaped by flowing façades, wave-inspired balconies and a restrained coastal palette. The interior concepts combine pale stone, warm timber and soft neutral tones, allowing the water and natural light to remain central to the experience. Project visuals show the intended design language; final materials, fixtures, appliances and furniture must follow the executed sale documents. The planned amenity programme includes indoor and outdoor fitness areas, walking trails, recreational lawns, barbecue facilities, a pool bar, steam and sauna facilities, and indoor and outdoor children's play areas. Beach access is also identified in the project material. Final access rights, operating arrangements and completion specifications remain subject to the governing documents. For an international second-home buyer, this residence offers the outdoor life of a private resort property within an apartment format. For a long-term purchaser, its proposition rests on rare, visible attributes rather than a forecast return: more than 306 m² of total space, a private-pool terrace larger than the interior, a seventh-floor corner position and two verified outlooks. Expected completion is Q3 2027, subject to the sale documents. A project-level schedule sets out 10% on booking, 40% during construction and 50% on completion; however, that schedule was issued for the first 100 residences. title: Majan, Dubai
description: Binghatti Titania at Majan is a high-rise 38-storey ultra-luxury advanced architectural excellence, above the podium levels, developed by leading Binghatti Developers . Laced with premium of the prime designed exclusive edition studios, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments to satisfy your luxury thirst to redefine the lifestyle. Being inspired from the Mythos tale, and rising with sovereign confidence as 3B+G+4P+32 residential floors with mech. and roof floor from the majan corridor. The tower commands immediate bold attention through a distinctive façade defined by a dark, metallic geometric grid that contrasts deliberately and dramatically against expansive glass surface, between structure and transparency that gives the building a rare character. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The result is a residential atmosphere that feels simultaneously expansive and intimate, modern and enduring, a place where the design draws back deliberately to place the resident and their sense of stillness at the centre of every room. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. The podium level opens into an adult infinity pool and shallow water pool that appear to dissolve into the Dubai skyline beyond as one of the tower's most photogenic and experientially powerful spaces. Families are catered for through a dedicated children's swimming pool paired with an Aqua Joy water splash zone, while the Little Marvels play area provides a curated outdoor environment for younger residents. Wellness is addressed through a yoga zone and a fully equipped gym, and the social dimension of community life is enriched through a floating pergola deck, outdoor seating areas, landscaped walkways, and abundant green spaces that soften the podium's urban edge. Residents also benefit from immediate proximity to Al Barari's cycling tracks and natural reserves, Majan Park, Majan Active Park, and the Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club, a constellation of leisure and green infrastructure. Project Highlights: The tower rises across 32 residential floors with a striking dark metallic geometric façade contrasting bold glass surfaces. A total of 789 residences span studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartment configurations across the entire development. Premium interiors feature Patagonia marble, Oakwood panelling, bronze trims, and signature green brushed steel throughout every residence. Residents enjoy direct road access to E311, Sheikh Zayed Road, Umm Suqeim Street, and Dubai-Al Ain Road. Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are reachable within fifteen to twenty-five minutes from the tower's Majan address. The amenity deck features an infinity pool, children's splash zone, yoga area, gym, and landscaped pergola deck.

description: Exclusive Beachfront Apartments with Installment on Siniyah Island, Umm Al-Quwain Siniyah Island, located off the coast of Umm Al Quwain in the United Arab Emirates, is a site of significant historical and ecological importance. Archaeological excavations have uncovered the oldest known pearl fishing town in the Persian Gulf on the island, dating back to the late 6th or early 7th century CE. Additionally, the discovery of an Eastern Christian monastery from the same period provides insight into the region's diverse cultural heritage. The island is also home to one of the largest remaining colonies of Socotra cormorants, highlighting its environmental significance. Recognizing its potential, the Umm Al Quwain government has initiated a development project to introduce leisure, hotel, and residential properties to Siniyah Island, aiming to blend its rich history with modern amenities. , are conveniently located just 10 minutes from Al Marjan Island, 30 minutes from Sharjah, 50 minutes from Downtown Dubai, and 60 minutes from Dubai International Airport. The project offers a luxurious seaside lifestyle, set amidst lush landscapes and serene surroundings. It seamlessly integrates natural beauty and refined architectural design, boasting pristine beaches with velvety white sands and crystal-clear turquoise waters. Residents enjoy direct beach and lagoon access, expansive views of the Arabian Gulf, and lush green vistas overlooking a meticulously designed 18-hole golf course. The development features premium amenities including an infinity swimming pool, an outdoor cinema, a state-of-the-art fitness centre, and multiple children's play areas. For leisure and relaxation, landscaped parks, tranquil gardens, and a vibrant community centre provide perfect spaces to unwind. Additionally, thrill-seekers can indulge in exhilarating water sports such as scuba diving, snorkeling, kite surfing, and paddleboarding. The retail boulevard offers a sensory feast with charming cafes and gourmet dining, enhancing the vibrant community atmosphere. Exclusive services such as a yacht club, a shopping mall, luxury resorts, and a helipad further elevate the sophisticated lifestyle experience provided by this prestigious island residence. The project offers elegantly designed interiors across a selection of premium 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments and duplexes, carefully crafted to blend modern comfort with sophisticated aesthetics. Each residence features contemporary layouts enhanced by spacious living areas and meticulous attention to detail. The interiors are equipped with stylish fitted wardrobes and fully integrated kitchen appliances, providing residents with convenience and luxury. Tower A exclusively offers fully furnished units, thoughtfully curated with tasteful furnishings and décor for immediate comfort and sophisticated living from day one. Towers B, C, and D present semi-furnished residences, allowing flexibility for personal touches to complement the refined interiors. Every apartment has been designed to create a harmonious living space that emphasizes both elegance and functionality, offering residents an exceptional lifestyle experience in a vibrant coastal setting. title: Business Bay, Dubai
raw_area: Business Bay, Business Bay, Dubai, Dubai
description: Apartments in Opus with World Famous Design in Dubai Business Bay The ultra-luxury apartments are located in Opus in Dubai Business Bay. The centrally located Opus stands out with its spectacular design and is in the middle of Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall. This architectural wonder not only attracts attention with its unique design but also serves as a vibrant cultural and artistic center. It is a popular nightlife destination offering a variety of dining options. The are within a 5-minute walk from major attractions such as Dubai Mall, Burj Khalifa, Dubai Opera, Business Bay, and Dubai Water Canal. They are also 20 minutes from Dubai International Airport and 30 minutes from Palm Jumeirah and Marina area. Opus is designed as two separate towers that coalesce into a single whole, taking the shape of a cube. The cube is then ''carved'' to create a central void within the building, which is an important volume in its own right and provides a view from the center of the building to the exterior. The two towers are linked by a four-story atrium at ground level with a bridge connecting 71 meters above the ground. The bridge is constructed with double-curved glass, double-curved aluminum frames, and steel elements. The bridge consists of three storeys offering spectacular views and the feeling of being at the top. The 96 units in Opus are available in a range of sizes, from one and two-bedroom apartments to exceptional duplexes and triplexes. They all have full access to hotel facilities and spectacular amenities. On your doorstep, you will find an eclectic variety of innovative food and beverage experiences, cultural events, and artistic performances. The project offers luxury services such as 24/7 security and valet services, secured basement parking, valet parking service for visitors, house cleaning service, laundry services, special discounts on food, beverage, and entertainment facilities, and in-home catering. In addition, there is a temperature-controlled swimming pool, spa access, gym, fitness center, and elegant dining venues for both residents and guests. DXB-00085
